parameters.name: AllowReport
parameters.description:
Specifies whether end users are allowed to submit a report request for this policy. Valid values:

- **true**: Reporting is allowed. The pop-up window on the endpoint provides a reporting entry.
- **false**: Reporting is not allowed.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the software ban policy. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be left empty.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
- **true**: Enabled. The policy is delivered to the endpoint and takes effect.
- **false**: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to the endpoint.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description: The scope in which the policy takes effect. Valid values:

parameters.description: The Chinese text of the secondary button in the pop-up window on the endpoint.

parameters.name: MinorButtonTextEn

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Policy Name of the software ban policy. Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.

parameters.description: The object type. Valid values:

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The action to take. Valid values:

- **Ban**: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification to the end user.
- **BanSilent**: Blocks the software from running without notifying the end user (silent blocking).
- **Warn**: Displays a pop-up notification to the end user without blocking the software from running.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: PromptCh
parameters.description: The Chinese prompt content displayed in the pop-up window on the endpoint.

parameters.name: PromptEn
parameters.description: The English prompt content displayed in the pop-up window on the endpoint.

parameters.name: SoftwareIds
parameters.description: The collection of banned software directly controlled by this policy.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The collection of banned software tag IDs controlled by this policy.

parameters.name: TitleCh

parameters.name: TitleEn

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
